component.name: Zero
component.summary: Post-quantum end-to-end encrypted messenger with zero user identifiers

description.p: Zero is an open-source, post-quantum end-to-end encrypted messenger with no phone numbers, no usernames, and no persistent user IDs.
Every conversation uses isolated pairwise unidirectional message queues, fixed 16 KB packet padding, and an augmented double ratchet combining Curve448 with sntrup761.

ol.li: End-to-end encrypted direct and group messaging with replies, edits, reactions, and disappearing timers.
Chunked encrypted file and media transfer over XFTP relays with SHA-512 verification.
One-time invitation links, 4-word contact phrases, 6-digit in-person pairing codes, and QR verification.
Optional 2-hop onion private routing and isolated SOCKS5 proxy support.
Encrypted peer-to-peer and TURN-relayed WebRTC audio and video calls.
Multiple local profiles protected by SQLCipher encryption and portable device linking.

description.p: First public v1.0.0 release across desktop, mobile, CLI, and runtime bindings:

ul.li: Deep-link scheme normalization and FastAPI contact-code broker test coverage.
Calibrated Argon2id (8 MiB) proof-of-work challenge verification and replay protection across clients.
Unified documentation, protocol whitepaper, and desktop packaging metadata.

description.p: Rate-limiting hardening, Compose Desktop focus fixes, and dependency-free Android FOSS build variant.
Multi-region NA/EU relay cluster templates, Coturn SSRF peer filters, and C11 JNI bounds audit.
Argon2id replay protection window tuning and SQLCipher background flush race fixes.
Contact-code broker for 4-word and 6-digit ephemeral contact discovery, frozen wire version ranges, and GHC 9.6.3 reproducible build scripts.
Aligned Node.js, Python, and TypeScript runtime packages and directory bot search/approval workflows.
Group and channel role controls, member security codes, signed history checkpoints, and multi-relay roster sync.
Remote device pairing hardening, link tracking sanitization, and Apple CommonCrypto CSPRNG compliance.
Chat list filters, batch message actions, group moderation reports, and SQLite query performance tuning.
Multiple isolated profiles, passcode-hidden profiles, pre-join member review, and group @mentions.
Encrypted WebRTC audio/video calling, local media encryption, and QR cross-device profile migration.
Post-quantum hybrid sntrup761 + X448 double ratchet, 2-hop onion routing, and SOCKS5 proxy isolation.
Initial Compose Multiplatform desktop and Android builds, XFTP chunked encrypted file transfer, reactions, and remote device control.
End-to-end encrypted groups, invitation URIs, delivery receipts, and initial iOS app targets.
Unidirectional SMP queues, fixed 16 KB packet padding, SPKI TLS pinning, and SQLCipher encrypted local database storage.
Initial core runtime, messaging broker libraries, C FFI boundary, and terminal CLI client.
